exposure: Presence and abundance of Clostridium perfringens and Bacteroides dorei in meconium
cohort: 11 neonates with NEC matched by gestational age and birthweight to 22 controls.
finding: Increased abundance of Clostridium perfringens and Bacteroides dorei in meconium was associated with NEC development, while increased staphylococci in post-meconium samples was negatively associated with NEC.
